LESSON: DESCANT RECORDER

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT CREATIVE ARTS
Strand: Performing and Displaying
Topic 2.5: Descant Recorder
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Descant Recorder, part of Performing and Displaying in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT CREATIVE ARTS.

Key inquiry question: How can a good tone be produced on the descant recorder?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Descant Recorder together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The learner uses digital devices to search and watch how to play notes on the descant recorder

• Learning to learn: The learner searches for and acquires skills of how to play new notes on the descant recorder.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: developed as learner searchers for appropriate materials to use for making a descant

recorder case.

Values:
• Respect: is instilled during group discussions as the listens to and accommodates peers’ views.

• Responsibility: is developed through taking care of the descant recorder and using digital devices.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Communicable diseases: Prevented by observation of hygiene measures in the use of the descant recorder.

• Social cohesion: enhanced through playing the descant recorder in groups.

Link to other learning areas:

Agriculture and Nutrition: Concepts and knowledge learnt on prevention of communicable diseases is applied in the use of the

descant recorder.

Suggested learning resources:

Open safe quite space, digital devices: laptops, tablets, phones, computers, cameras pictures, Descant recorder, Baroque

fingering chart, Recorder melodies based on G, A B yarns, pieces of cloth, crochet, needles, threads,
